drafts.text:
Blown a fuse? Don't wrap it in foil or stick a penny in there.

A fuse is a one-time safety device. When it melts, it's done its job.

Replace it with the right amperage, or call us if you're not sure what's blowing it.

SoLit Electric, Baton Rouge. 225-472-1165
drafts.video_tip: Video tip (@solitelectric, about 15 sec, phone vertical): Close-up of a real fuse vs a breaker in a panel. Point to the fuse: 'One-time. Melts. Done.' Point to the breaker: 'Resettable. Flip it back.' On-screen text: 'Blown fuse? Don't wrap it in foil.' End card: SoLit Electric, Baton Rouge, 225-472-1165. Real panel, real footage.

drafts.text:
Halloween lights going up this weekend?

Use outdoor-rated cords, GFCI outlets, and don't daisy-chain a pile of strands.

If the GFCI trips and you reset it and it trips again, stop. That's the outlet doing its job.

SoLit Electric. 225-472-1165

Hosting Thanksgiving or holiday lights that always trip a breaker?

That old panel might be telling you it's out of room.

SoLit Electric is owned by licensed master electrician Yancie David. Panels, generators, EV chargers, 24/7 emergency in Baton Rouge.
